sentences.ar: ג'וחא שלח את הבן שלו למים.
sentences.en: Juha sent his son for water.

sentences.ar: הוא נתן לו כד גדול ויפה.
sentences.en: He gave him a big, fine jar.
Before the son went out of the house.
Juha gave him a light blow.
The son shouted: why did you strike me?

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: לא עשיתי שום דבר.
sentences.en: He said: I did not do anything.
Juha said: that is for the jar.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: אם תשבור אותו, זה כואב.
sentences.en: He said: if you break it, it hurts.
A neighbour stood outside and saw everything.

sentences.ar: הוא נכנס ואמר: זה לא נכון.
sentences.en: He came in and said: that is not right.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: הוא עוד לא שבר.
sentences.en: He said: he has not broken it yet.
Juha said: and when he breaks it?

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: אז יהיה מאוחר מדי.
sentences.en: He said: then it will be too late.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: הכד כבר לא יחזור.
sentences.en: He said: the jar will not come back.

sentences.ar: השכן שתק ולא ידע מה לומר.
sentences.en: The neighbour was silent and did not know what to say.
The son went and brought water quietly.
